title: XOR of the leading bits
statement: For bits $b,c$ and bit strings $p,u$, apply the pair-output rule to the encoding of $b$ followed by $p$ and $c$ followed by $u$. The result is the one-bit string whose bit is the XOR of $b$ and $c$.
